title: ToolBelt Unlimited
description: Increases the slot limit of ToolBelt according to Config
body:
Allows more Slots fpr the Toolbelt, with a maximum set via the config.
Also change the Slots the be Compatible for all #c:tools items (toolbelt only allows nonStackable), also changable via the config.

Dependencies: 
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sewing-kit https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tool-belt
